deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'if [ "$NGRAM_RAILWAY_ROLE" = "api" ]; then exec /app/docker/entrypoint-railway.sh -m ngram.main api --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT:-8080}"; elif [ "$NGRAM_RAILWAY_ROLE" = "hands" ]; then exec /app/docker/entrypoint-railway.sh -m ngram.main hands --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT:-8080}"; elif [ -n "$NGRAM_ENTITY" ]; then exec /app/docker/entrypoint-railway.sh -m ngram.main worker "$NGRAM_ENTITY"; else echo "Railway: set NGRAM_RAILWAY_ROLE=api or hands, or set NGRAM_ENTITY for the worker." >&2; exit 1; fi'
